title: pane_run reads herdr's raw exit, not a JSON envelope
action: Fix-first: RealHerdr::pane_run currently routes through call(), which requires a JSON envelope, but `herdr pane run` emits plain/empty stdout — so the always-on BEE_HERDING_WORKER export (hws-1) kills EVERY fresh spawn with 'env export failed: ... not valid JSON' (live: job hlp-1-r1, pane w4:p13). Rewrite pane_run as a raw Command invocation like the old pane_text: success = exit status 0, stdout ignored; stderr trimmed into the error on nonzero.

truths: pane_run succeeds on exit-0 regardless of stdout shape

trace.outcome: pane_run reads raw exit status; JSON-envelope parse removed

report.outcome: RealHerdr::pane_run is a raw Command invocation — success is exit 0, stdout ignored, stderr trimmed into the error; fixes every fresh spawn dying on the always-on BEE_HERDING_WORKER export
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml herding — 180 passed, 0 real failures — the touched module suite

checks.evidence: RealHerdr::pane_run is a raw Command call — success is exit 0, stdout ignored, stderr in the error; live re-dispatch hlp-1-r2 spawned clean where hlp-1-r1 died on 'not valid JSON'
